business_summary: Well Link Securities Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides brokerage services for futures, securities, and options traded on the exchanges in Hong Kong. The company operates through Brokerage and margin financing services; and Money Lending segments. It also provides margin financing, money lending, and bond and fund services. The company was formerly known as Excalibur Global Financial Holdings Limited and changed its name to Well Link Securities Holdings Limited in January 2024. Well Link Securities Holdings Limited was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. Well Link Securities Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Well Link Fintech Holdings Limited.
business_summary_ko: Well Link Securities Holdings Limited는 자회사와 함께 홍콩 거래소에서 거래되는 선물, 증권 및 옵션에 대한 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 중개 및 마진 금융 서비스를 통해 운영됩니다. 및 자금 대출 부문. 또한 마진 파이낸싱, 자금 대출, 채권 및 펀드 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Excalibur Global Financial Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2024년 1월에 Well Link Securities Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Well Link Securities Holdings Limited는 1993년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 셩완에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Well Link Securities Holdings Limited는 Well Link Fintech Holdings Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
